# --- hand-marked, below the measurement's resolution ---
#
# 가드_남_1 is the case that started this. Royal Guard has no weapon art of its
# own -- 로얄가드/ is byte-identical to 크루세이더/ -- so its sword is drawn for
# the Crusader silhouette, and this armour variant is ~7px narrower than that
# body at the shoulders. The hilt hangs clear of the hand. It measures 2px
# narrower by the width test, which is where correct bodies sit, so no threshold
# reaches it without taking 로드페코_여 and the 룬나이트쁘띠 mounts with it.
# The real client renders it the same way; it resolves to the same file.
남	가드_남_1	로얄가드	manual
